resources.string: Phone-only settings; nothing is written to the earbuds. Thresholds set each ear’s color even when reminders are off. Connecting still shows a five-second battery report.
Enter whole numbers from 1 to 99, with Low below Medium. Below Low is red, Low through Medium is yellow, and above Medium is green. Save applies both thresholds and switches together.
Report when either ear falls to Low, at most once per ear per connection. An initial low reading does not trigger a reminder.
Report when either ear falls to Medium, at most once per ear per connection. This switch is independent of the Low reminder.
Not saved. Both thresholds must be whole numbers from 1 to 99, and Low must be less than Medium. Your saved settings are unchanged.

Your previous ear threshold cannot be combined with the new Medium threshold. The original configuration is retained for recovery; 20% Low and 50% Medium are in use for now. Review both thresholds and tap Save to confirm.
These are sample values, not live battery readings. Valid edits update each color independently. This preview never posts a notification.
The threshold pair is not valid yet. The preview uses your last saved thresholds.
Could not save battery notification settings on this phone. Your saved settings are unchanged. Try again.
